note.subject: geography
note.why_in_news: IMD Director-General Mrutyunjay Mohapatra projected a normal Northeast monsoon despite a 20% Southwest monsoon deficit, impacting rainfall distribution across India.
note.fact_box: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) reported a 20% deficit in the Southwest monsoon. Rainfall for the Northeast monsoon is expected to be normal to above normal in coastal Tamil Nadu starting the third week of October.

prelims_pointers.text: Southwest monsoon deficit recorded at 20% for the current season.
Coastal Tamil Nadu and South India are primary recipients of Northeast monsoon rainfall.
Northeast monsoon typically begins in October and provides significant rainfall to the Coromandel Coast.

note.fact_box: In FY26, 87.7% of individual equity derivatives traders lost a total of Rs 91,685 crore. Options trading accounted for 92% of these losses, with an average loss of Rs 1.17 lakh per trader.

note.subject: social_justice
note.why_in_news: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched the Vettri Payanam Thittam in Chennai to expand free bus travel for women across the state.
note.fact_box: The scheme covers 12,695 buses (approx. 69% of the 18,413 fleet) operated by seven State transport corporations. It is an expansion of the Magalir Vidiyal Payanam scheme, aiming to benefit 84.32 lakh women daily at an estimated annual cost of ₹6,000 crore.

prelims_pointers.text: Vettri Payanam Thittam: Expansion of the Magalir Vidiyal Payanam scheme for free bus travel for women in Tamil Nadu.
The scheme covers 12,695 buses out of a total of 18,413 operated by state transport corporations.
The scheme excludes Chengalpattu and Tiruppur districts from the rollout as of October 2, 2026.
The scheme covers Ordinary, Express, LSS (Limited Stop Service), and Deluxe bus services in cities/towns.

note.mains_question: Evaluate the role of state-sponsored free public transport in promoting women's socio-economic empowerment and labor force participation.
